# Lab 05 – SysOps Alert Forecasting with Prophet

## Objective

Forecast future system alerts using Facebook Prophet.

---

## Tools Used

- Python
- Prophet
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Matplotlib

---

## Tasks Performed

- Generated historical alert data
- Trained Prophet forecasting model
- Forecasted next 30 days
- Saved prediction results
- Visualized forecast
- Generated trend and seasonality plots

---

## Generated Files

```text
forecast_alerts.py
historical_alerts.csv
forecast_results.csv
alert_forecast.png
forecast_components.png
sysops_forecast_report.txt
requirements.txt
```

---

## Conclusion

Facebook Prophet successfully forecasted future system alerts using historical data. Such forecasting enables proactive system monitoring and helps anticipate periods of increased alert activity.
